# goslop text fixture — niquests stream close smoke: await r.close() is the
# resource-cleanup verification (test_explicit_close_in_streaming_response).
lang: python
file: tests/test_async.py
---
from niquests import AsyncSession


async def test_explicit_close_in_streaming_response() -> None:
    async with AsyncSession() as s:
        try:
            r = await s.get("https://httpbingo.org/html", stream=True)
        finally:
            await r.close()
